projectDesc.p: This transcription was made by the International Greek New Testament Project in its work towards the Editio Critica Maior.

editorialDecl.p: This transcription was produced using the online transcription editor developed by the Center for Digital Humanities at the University of Trier as part of the Workspace for Collaborative Editing Project between 2010 and 2013 and made available for use by the Institute for Textual Scholarship and Electronic Editing and the University of Birmingham.
The XML specifications used are version 1.6 of the IGNTP Guidelines available at

revisionDesc.change: Proofread against digital photographs by acm 19.9.18. Book number moved after page break. 1v3 Correction added * υμων C ημων. 1v9 αρτι changed to αρτη. 1v11 ευαγγελισθεν changed to ευηγγελισθεν. 1v11 εστι changed to εστιν. 1v15 Correction added * gap=2char C del. 1v23 ευαγγελιζητε changed to ευαγγελιζεται. 2v3 Uncertain tags on περι removed. 2v10 συνιστημι changed to συνιστανω. 3v2 ελαβετε changed to ελαβεται. 3v4 επαθετε changed to επαθατε. 3v16 Correction altered * ερεθησαν C ερρεθησαν. 3v18 Uncertain tags removed from κεχαρισται. 4v9 Correction altered from just τε to * μαλλοντες C μαλλον. 4v9 επηστρεφητε changed to επιστρεφητε. 4v13 ευηγγελισαμην changed to ευηγγελισαμιν. 4v24 Correction added * δηαθηκαι C διαθηκαι. 5v1 ηλευθερωσιν changed to ηλευθερωσεν. 5v3 οφειλιτης changed to οφειλετης. 5v8 Uncertain tags removed from πεισθηναι. 5v15 υπο changed to υπ. 5v26 κενοδοξοι changed to κενωδοξοι. 6v8 Correction added * σαρκαν C σαρκα. by Amy Myshrall
